quality.review_scope: Entire scoped main-paper contribution: all 12 main pages, methods and Figures 1–6; missing SI explicitly excluded from reading credit. Source discrepancies, modeling and reference values remain qualified.
missing_fields: Matching supporting information was not located in the bounded existing-local-file search. SI figures/tables cited by the main paper have not been independently read.
No measured atomic coordinates, unprinted curve values, complete physical batch joins or unreported operating values are reconstructed.
General vacuum-oven drying duration, vacuum level, ligand coverage and exact particle loss are not reported.
